term.name: exi_options
term.definition: The parameters of an that its decoder must know (EXI 1.0, section 5.4): alignment, the fidelity options, strict, fragment, selfContained, schemaId, datatypeRepresentationMap, blockSize, valueMaxLength and valuePartitionCapacity. Carried in the stream header as an options document, or known out of band; sxml_exi_options in C ().
